resources.string: Total internal storage (Knox)
Bytes reported by Samsung DeviceInventory for internal SD card and phone memory.
Bytes (By); this is capacity, not I/O throughput.
Low available capacity can limit writes, updates and temporary files; total capacity provides device context.
Compare available capacity over time on the same device and source. OEM and Android volumes may differ; do not add or average them.
A declining available value during work indicates storage consumption; it does not prove slow flash or a CPU bottleneck.
Deprecated since Knox API 35. A missing card, -1, unavailable method or denied access produces no numeric sample. No universal threshold is assumed.
Not used in Performance State in this release. Missing data is not zero.
Samsung Knox DeviceInventory, device scope. Read on the OEM worker at the Device category interval (default daily).
